questions.prompt: Which learning objective is most directly associated with “Logging and Monitoring Data Processing”?
options: Apply logging and monitoring data processing to the relevant part of a structured-data workflow and verify the result.

questions.answer_key: Apply logging and monitoring data processing to the relevant part of a structured-data workflow and verify the result.
questions.explanation: The lesson is scoped to logging and monitoring data processing. The correct approach is to apply the relevant concept to structured data and verify the output rather than relying on assumptions.

questions.prompt: What is the most reliable way to check work involving logging and monitoring data processing?

Assume the operation cannot change the result shape.

questions.answer_key: Inspect relevant labels, dtypes, missing values, row counts, and expected results.
questions.explanation: Validation makes the expected data shape and behavior explicit. Check the fields and edge cases that affect this operation before treating the result as trustworthy.
